description: Update PRs for pinned versions. Merged updates reach the box with the Sunday 05:00 pull (README: Weekly self-update).

packageRules.description: Small updates merge themselves once the release is 3 days old (no CI: ignoreTests).
Vaultwarden holds the passwords: minor releases can migrate the database, so only patches merge themselves.
Immich: server and machine learning must run the same version, so one PR updates both. Every update waits for a manual merge: Immich breaks things in minor releases too.
prBodyNotes: **Before merging:** read the release notes for every version in between (breaking changes are listed at the top), compare that release's `docker-compose.yml` with ours (postgres/valkey pins, new settings), and run `sudo homelab-backup critical` on the box first so a fresh database dump is in the backup.

packageRules.description: Immich's Postgres and Valkey: pinned by Immich (tag + digest). Change them only when an Immich release does; never a Postgres major by hand.
prBodyNotes: **Usually close this PR:** take these pins from Immich's release `docker-compose.yml` instead, when updating Immich.

packageRules.description: rclone: the pinned checksum must change in the same PR, and the Mac should match.
prBodyNotes: **Before merging:** set `backup_rclone_sha256` to the `rclone-v{{newVersion}}-linux-amd64.deb` line of https://downloads.rclone.org/v{{newVersion}}/SHA256SUMS (push it to this branch), and run `brew upgrade rclone` on the Mac so both match.

customManagers.description: rclone .deb pinned in the backup role
